column1: # TRANS-SIXFRAME-001 (B02 FIN WP12): EMBOSS 6.6.0 getorf reference output (binary /usr/bin/getorf) for IUPAC
# (ambiguity codes, N runs, lower case, U) sequences, linear and -circular Y; generated 2026-10-14 by:
#   getorf -sequence lock12.fa -outseq stdout -find M -table T -minsize MIN -maxsize MAX -flanking F -reverse REV
#   -methionine MET -circular CIRC -auto  (one run per C line; records in getorf output order; sequences verbatim).
# Sequences avoid the codons whose EMBOSS ambiguous translation (trnComplete) differs from the all-expansions rule in
# STOP status or by a non-X residue (table 1/11: TRA, TRR, ATS, YTN, WSN, MGN; table 2: WRR, YTN, WSN), and every
# frame of the tripled sequence (both strands) holds a STOP, so no circular full-length record occurs.
# R<TAB>configId<TAB>seqName<TAB>orfNo<TAB>s<TAB>e<TAB>F|R<TAB>sequence   (s, e = getorf header [s - e]; R = (REVERSE SENSE))
